- Preserve local code; do not reset, overwrite, or delete approved work without explicit authorization.
- Do not deploy until OTP plaintext persistence is eliminated and focused OTP tests pass.
- Do not certify production without independently matching `GitHub HEAD = Actions source SHA = Render deployed SHA = live /version SHA`.
- Continue QA that does not require unavailable canonical-provider credentials.

- Treat `/health`, `/version`, and `/readiness` as proof of a healthy live runtime at `012bb088...`, not proof of GitHub, Actions, or Render provenance.

- Record the Expo lint result as a release-gate failure until `eslint` is properly declared and installed.
- Treat focused regressions and full Expo tests as passing local gates; they do not establish production provenance.

- 4. Execute authorized owner/member success-path QA against the SHA-matched deployment.
- 5. Validate primary AI provider operation rather than fallback behavior.
- 6. Build and device-test release artifacts from the final canonical merged SHA.
- 7. Issue a new certification verdict only if the provenance chain and release gates are complete.
